options.markdown:
ALB logs

These charts refer to the Application load balancer logs. To configure Application load balancer logs follow this AWS documentation. To configure the logs on Splunk Enterprise/Cloud follow this Splunk Add-on for AWS documentation. For more information on sending logs to Splunk Log Observer Connect, see Log Observer Connect documentation.
